description: This file defines an API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of a project activity name within a human resource management system. The class includes methods for handling GET requests that check whether a given activity name is already taken within a specified project, supporting functionality such as retrieving project and activity data, performing validation, and returning validation results.

classes.name: ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating project activity names for uniqueness within the OrangeHRM time management module. It handles GET requests to check if a project activity name is available and applies validation rules to input parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to validate whether a project activity name is unique within a project. Retrieves project and activity data, performs checks via DAO, and returns a boolean indicating if the name can be used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring 'id' is positive, 'activityName' is a string with a maximum length, and 'activityId' if provided is positive.
